image_description: A white and blue minibus parked on an asphalt surface. The vehicle features a boxy body, a row of side windows, and a large windshield. There is prominent text on the side reading 'AIRARE RO' and on the front bumper. The bus has standard wheels and visible headlights/taillights.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof, short-wheelbase proportions of a minibus (likely a Ford Transit or similar chassis). The height relative to the wheel size confirms passenger capacity.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large, single-pane windshield is clearly visible. A continuous row of rectangular side windows runs along the passenger compartment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The sliding entrance door is located immediately behind the front driver's cabin, which is a standard configuration for this class of vehicle.
The door panel shows vertical seams and a handle consistent with a sliding mechanism typical of vans/minibuses.
The short hood ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout, distinct from rear-engine full-size buses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is taken from a front-three-quarter angle; the rear of the vehicle is completely occluded and outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bus has a two-tone white and blue livery with specific branding/text markings on the side and front.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front wheel matches the scale and design of standard commercial van wheels, with a realistic tire sidewall and rim structure.
Based on the window count (approx. 5-6 side windows) and overall length, the seating capacity aligns with the 4-10 passenger definition.

artifact_observations.location: Side panel text ('AIRARE RO') and front bumper text
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the side appears to be pseudo-text or a hallucinated brand name ('AIRARE RO'). The characters are mostly legible but the kerning and font consistency show slight AI artifacts. The front license plate/text is illegible gibberish, a common AI generation trait.
The reflections in the side windows are somewhat muddy and lack the crisp environmental mapping expected in a real photograph, appearing slightly 'painted' or smeared.

artifact_observations.location: Front headlight assembly (right side of image)
artifact_observations.reasoning: The geometry of the front headlight cluster is slightly irregular and doesn't perfectly align with the body lines, suggesting minor geometric warping typical of generative models.
